launch_condition: A single canonical R1 run must admit both Berserk and Ethereal under the frozen PSM_READ contract. The already observed Berserk-only PASS cannot by itself authorize R2.

stockfish_19_bridge.role: same-world bridge from the P19 Stockfish lineage into the heterogeneous engine-family court

fresh_world_constitution.authority: same exact-world/Syzygy fine-value constitution as P19, but a disjoint deterministic generation namespace

pre_intervention_selection.joint_engagement: Each committed cell must show positive MAIN and QSEARCH PSM_READ engagement on all three targets.
pre_intervention_selection.commitment: 12 cells per vertex, 6 WHITE + 6 BLACK, selected deterministically by the minimum cross-target minimum-site SHAM hit count and then candidate hash.

runtime.census_role: SHAM-only engagement and deterministic selection; no selective intervention outcomes

common_outcome_space.rule: Do not infer WDL from engine centipawn scores.

engine_family_naturality.pairwise_same_world_test: For each matched square and target pair, compare H vectors on exactly the same committed cells.
engine_family_naturality.strict_diagram_compatibility: curvature class equal AND dominant coordinate/sign equal when CURVED AND L_inf(H_a-H_b) <= 1/12
engine_family_naturality.replicated_cross_family_curvature: At least two distinct engine families are CURVED on the same square with the same dominant coordinate and sign.
engine_family_naturality.interpretation_ceiling: Compatibility is evidence for relation-level transport under this PSM_READ intervention contract and resource/world scope, not representation identity or universal engine equivalence.

secondary_lanes.inanis: No forced MAIN/QSEARCH square; topology-specific quotient/translation constitution remains separate.
secondary_lanes.lc0: No intervention in R2; architecture-neutral ontology boundary remains separate.

transport_binary_portability.principle: R1 causal admission binds the source-locked adapter contract, not a runner-specific machine-code artifact.
transport_binary_portability.trigger: The first R2 artifact-reuse attempt produced an Illegal instruction on Berserk before any SHAM census or selective transport outcome.
transport_binary_portability.repair: Rebuild Berserk and Ethereal from the same locked sources and admitted adapter patchers using portable non-native ISA flags, then rerun the full 3-FEN baseline=NATIVE=SHAM and MASK_ALL=semantic-removal admission gate on those exact transport binaries.
transport_binary_portability.binary_identity_rule: The exact revalidated transport binary hashes are frozen into the R2 SHAM precommit and must be reused for all selective arms.
